name: Aligned Fan-In
description: Joins multiple input streams whose records share a common event-time alignment (e.g., watermark boundaries or time windows). The join emits a combined record only when aligned tuples from all upstream sources arrive within the same logical window.
when_to_use: Multiple ordered event streams must be combined by time
Watermarks or windowing semantics guarantee alignment
Late or out-of-order events must be deferred until window closes
benefits: Deterministic join semantics for time-aligned streams
Enables complex event processing with predictable output
drawbacks: Sensitive to skew — slowest stream gates latency
State cost grows with window length
use_cases: Click-stream + impression-stream join by session window
Sensor + actuator fusion at sampled boundaries

relationships.description: Use when streams are not time-aligned
